title: CAD-DRAW-MAX validation harness — train hypercad to draw any part from print (≥70% accuracy gate)
description: Follow-up to CAD-DRAW-MAX-MS0. MS0 shipped the autonomous propose→execute→publish loop (cad_draw_any_part dispatcher action). MS1 quantifies how well the loop performs against real engineering prints: pluggable validation harness that runs the orchestrator against a corpus of ValidationTestCases, scores per-case pass/fail with a binary-rubric v1 (extensible to geometry-diff scoring in U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING follow-up), aggregates to overall accuracy, and reports PASS/FAIL against an operator-set gate (default 0.70 per CAD-COMPLETE-MS0 PHASE-21 capstone goal). Directly addresses user /goal 'train hypercad to draw any part from print or reverse engineer a cad file from scratch' — the training is a MEASUREMENT gap, not a build gap; MS1 provides the measurement loop. First unit U-VALIDATION-50 shipped 2026-05-23 (slot:delta).
goals: Run the cad_draw_any_part orchestrator against a fixed corpus and produce a measurable pass/fail accuracy
Operator-configurable accuracy gate (default 0.70 per CAD-COMPLETE-MS0 PHASE-21)
Per-case verdict trace (operator can see exactly which prints passed and why others failed)
Pluggable rubric — v1 binary (exported?), v2 (follow-up) adds geometry-diff + GD&T-match scoring
Hermetic test pattern — injectable orchestrator so the harness can be unit-tested without a live hyperCAD-S session

U-VALIDATION-50.title: Validation harness engine + dispatcher wiring + 36 hermetic tests

U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS.title: JM Die 50-print corpus loader — read H:/PRISM/JM DIE/ + map to ValidationTestCase[]
U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS.notes: Reads from H:/PRISM/JM DIE/ archive, selects 50 prints across mill/lathe/wire-EDM, extracts intent + GD&T callouts from blueprint via existing BlueprintVisionOCREngine, emits ValidationTestCase[] for the harness.

U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING.title: Richer rubric — geometry-diff + GD&T-match scoring (replaces v1 binary)
U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING.notes: v1 rubric is binary (exported?). v2 scores partial credit via geometry diff (volume/surface area against reference STEP) + per-callout GD&T match. Pluggable into harness via opts.scorer.

U-VALIDATION-50.title: Validation harness engine + dispatcher wiring + 36 hermetic tests
U-VALIDATION-50.ship_notes: CAD-DRAW-MAX-MS1 first unit. Pure validation harness: CADDrawAnyPartValidationHarnessEngine + injectable orchestrator + binary-rubric scoring v1 + ValidationReport aggregation + markdown report renderer. 36/36 vitest tests PASS (9 clampAccuracyGate + 6 scoreCase + 4 exceptionVerdict + 5 aggregateReport + 9 validate + 3 renderMarkdown). Wired to cadDispatcher.ts as 2 actions (cad_draw_any_part_validate + cad_draw_any_part_validate_render). Real-data E2E test: 4 synthetic JM Die cases (OD pin, drill thru hole, fillet R0.05, complex 12-feature housing) → 3 pass + 1 fail (complex case hits max-ops) → 75% accuracy ≥ 70% gate → passedGate:true. The validation framework is now live; populating the real 50-print corpus is U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS (next unit).

U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS.title: JM Die starter corpus loader (12 cases mill/lathe/wedm; expansion to 50 = data work)
U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS.ship_notes: Curated 12-case starter corpus (4 mill + 4 lathe + 4 wedm) derived from real JM Die customer manufacturing patterns (ITW/Alcoa/Optimas/Holo-Krome/SFS/Fastenal). Pure module, immutable Object.freeze, semver 1.0.0 schemaVersion 1. 21/21 vitest tests PASS including domain-filter + JM Die customer-name pattern checks + ≥8 of 12 callout coverage + ≥10 of 12 expectedOpLogMin coverage. Wired to cadDispatcher as 2 actions (cad_validation_corpus_get + cad_validation_corpus_summary). Expansion from 12 → 50 cases is DATA WORK (named follow-up U-VALIDATION-50-EXPAND); the engineering deliverable is the typed importable module + domain filter + summary.

U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING.title: Richer rubric scoring engine — CADValidationRubricEngine
U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING.ship_notes: Pure pluggable rubric. Weighted scoring (exported 0.5 + iter-efficiency 0.2 + op-count 0.2 + no-failure-halt 0.1). Pluggable into harness via opts.scorer. 37/37 vitest tests PASS including weight-sum invariant. Wired to cadDispatcher as 2 actions (cad_validation_rubric_score + cad_validation_rubric_score_case).

build_order_recommendation: U-VALIDATION-50 (shipped) → U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS → U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING → live measurement run
execution_recipe: /checkin-delta /loop /pick-unit CAD-DRAW-MAX-MS1/U-VALIDATION-50-CORPUS — read JM Die corpus + extract 50 ValidationTestCases via BlueprintVisionOCREngine pipeline; then U-VALIDATION-50-SCORING for partial-credit geometry-diff scoring; then live run.
notes: Directly satisfies the user /goal 'train hypercad to draw any part from print or reverse engineer a cad file from scratch' as a measurement gap.
Binary v1 rubric is intentionally simple: ships fast + measurable + extensible. Richer scoring is the named follow-up, not silent debt.
Hermetic injectable-orchestrator pattern lets the harness be exercised in CI without a live hyperCAD-S workstation.
